name: retro-futurism-arcade — reference build
_note: TUNE THE REGIONS BEFORE THE FIRST REAL RUN. Every region below is a
fraction of the viewport and they are guesses until someone has looked at
one frame of the built game. The procedure is in gate.md, section
'Calibrating a target'. An untuned region is the one way this harness can
produce a false red, so calibration is part of running it, not optional.
selectors.floatingScore requires the build to tag its floating-score nodes
with data-gate="floating-score"; see gate.md, 'What the build must expose'.
_calibration: Measured 2026-09-06 against Reference/retro-futurism-arcade at 1280x720 by row-wise luminance profiling of a real frame, replacing the original guesses. Row peaks at y=0.15/0.225/0.30/0.375/0.45 are the five invader rows; the sustained bright band at 0.775-0.85 is the bunkers; the ship sits at 0.925-0.975. The previous playerBand (0.76-0.91) and bunkerBand (0.65-0.75) both missed their subjects entirely, which is why every player-movement verb failed against a build whose own probe showed the ship moving. sceneryBand is now a left-edge sliver of city: static, feature-rich enough for a camera-shake signal, and outside the horizontal reach of the formation, the bunkers and the ship, so nothing but the camera can move it.
